zh.title: 北羅格曼與波音完成MQ-4C Triton與P-8A Poseidon首次自動人機協同示範
zh.summary: 北羅格曼與波音完成MQ-4C、P-8A首次自動人機協同示範
body: 北羅格曼與波音於2026年8月6日發布的 Aerospace Global News 報導指出，兩公司已完成他們所描述的「第一次自動人機協同示範」，涉及MQ-4C Triton海上監視無人機與P-8A Poseidon海上巡邏機。
該示範在實驗室環境中進行，利用人工智慧與開放式系統介面，使兩機系統能夠共享情報、規劃任務並協同執行海上監視與反水面作戰任務。
一名P-8A操作員下達指示，讓模擬的Triton飛往預定區域；Triton接著自行規劃航線、啟動其傳感器、在機上處理所得資訊，並將結果回傳至P-8A。
資料傳輸部分透過衛星中繼進行，以模擬真實作戰通訊；任務管理系統透過Open Mission Systems與Universal Command and Control Interface交換指示，而非依賴專屬點對點連線。
北羅格曼與波音表示，此 jointly funded 技術示範的目的在於展示「兩系統在開放系統架構下協同自動化任務控制」的能力，並相信此舉可降低操作員工作量、加速決策並讓新平台更易、更低成本地接入。
兩家公司進一步指出，透過標準化介面，Triton與Poseidon能夠實現機對機的任務規劃與執行，此種共通標準旨在讓美軍及其 allied 平台未來無需為每種機型組合重新開發點對點整合方案。
報導同時提及，Triton為美國海軍計畫採購68架（截至2026年中已交付約43架），而澳洲皇家空軍則為Triton的唯一出口用戶，並同時擁有P-8A機隊。

en.title: Northrop Grumman and Boeing Complete First Automated MQ-4C Triton–P-8A Poseidon Manned-Unmanned Teaming Demonstration
en.summary: Northrop Grumman and Boeing complete first automated MQ-4C and P-8A teaming demonstration
body: According to Aerospace Global News dated August 6, 2026, Northrop Grumman and Boeing have completed what they describe as the first automated manned-unmanned teaming demonstration between an MQ-4C Triton maritime surveillance drone and a P-8A Poseidon maritime patrol aircraft.

The demonstration took place in a laboratory setting, employing artificial intelligence and open-system interfaces to enable the two aircraft systems to share intelligence, plan missions, and coordinate maritime surveillance and anti-surface warfare tasks.

A P-8A operator instructed a simulated Triton to fly to a designated area; the Triton then autonomously planned its transit, activated its sensors, processed the gathered information onboard, and transmitted the findings back to the Poseidon.

Data exchange was partially routed through a satellite relay to simulate realistic operational communications, with the mission-management systems communicating via Open Mission Systems and the Universal Command and Control Interface rather than relying on a bespoke point-to-point link.

Northrop Grumman and Boeing characterized the effort as a jointly funded technology demonstration intended to show the "ability for the two systems to collaborate and automate mission control over open systems architecture," noting that such interoperability could reduce operator workload, speed decision-making, and simplify future platform integration.

The companies added that the standardized interface used enables machine-to-machine mission planning and execution across platforms, a capability they hope will allow U.S. and allied forces to connect various aircraft without needing new point-to-point integrations for each combination.

The report also notes that the U.S. Navy plans to acquire 68 MQ-4C Tritons, with around 43 delivered by mid‑2026, while the Royal Australian Air Force operates both the Triton and the P‑8A Poseidon, having received its final P‑8A in May 2026.

zh.title: 國際女飛行員協會推動全球擴展計畫
zh.summary: Women in Aviation International 執行長 Lynda Coffman 於今年法恩堡羅國際航空展中表示，該組織正擴大國際佈局，在歐洲、亞洲及非洲等地設立新分會，並依各地經濟指數調降會費，以降低加入門檻，吸引更多女性投入航空業。
body: Women in Aviation International（WAI）執行長 Lynda Coffman 在今年法恩堡羅國際航空展受訪時表示，這個成立三十六年的非營利組織正加強全球擴展計畫，目標是建立更堅實的國際網絡、消除會費障礙，並鼓勵更多女性投入這個傳統上以男性為主的產業。
Coffman 本人在聯合航空擁有三十年職涯，最終擔任該航空公司總裁，並為 United Ground Express 創辦總裁。她指出，WAI 目前約有兩萬名會員，但多數位於美國，因此組織現正聚焦提升國際能見度，涵蓋歐洲、亞洲、非洲等地區。
在分會網絡方面，WAI 在美國已有超過一百個分會，現正於歐洲（包括英國）、亞洲及非洲設立更多分會。近期新增的分會涵蓋泰國、新加坡、東歐及若干非洲國家。Coffman 表示，英國分會的籌建工作尤其受到重視。
為支援國際擴展，WAI 重新調整會費結構。Coffman 說明年費為五十九美元，但組織依各地經濟指數調降費用，部分地區降幅達三分之二。她指出，會費減少所造成的資金缺口已由董事會成員透過捐款全額補足。
WAI 的全球導師計畫利用人工智慧，依據經驗、職涯目標、所在地及專業挑戰配對導師與學員。Coffman 以去年「年度導師」得主為例，該名位於杜拜的導師成功指導一名美國會員，展現計畫跨越國界的運作模式。
Coffman 補充，儘管組織名稱強調女性，約百分之二十的會員為男性，董事會中亦有兩名男性成員。她強調組織不歧視，歡迎男性盟友參與。

en.title: Women in Aviation International Steps Up Global Expansion Plans
en.summary: Women in Aviation International CEO Lynda Coffman said at this year's Farnborough International Airshow that the non-profit is expanding its international profile by establishing new chapters across Europe, Asia and Africa, and restructuring membership fees based on regional economic indices to lower barriers to joining.
body: Women in Aviation International (WAI) CEO Lynda Coffman said during this year's Farnborough International Airshow that the 36-year-old non-profit organisation is stepping up its global expansion plans to build a stronger international network, remove financial barriers to membership and inspire more women to pursue careers in a traditionally male-dominated sector.

Coffman, who has a 30-year career history at United Airlines culminating in her role as president of the airline and founding president of United Ground Express, said WAI currently has around 20,000 members, the majority based in the US. The organisation is now focused on raising its international profile across Europe, Asia, Africa and beyond.

WAI has more than 100 chapters in the US and is working to establish more chapters across Europe, including the UK, as well as in Asia and Africa. Recent additions include new chapters in Thailand, Singapore, Eastern Europe and several African countries. Coffman said there is significant energy around building UK chapters.

To support international expansion, WAI has restructured its fees. Coffman said annual membership costs US$59, but the organisation looked at areas of the world and their economic index to lower fees where needed, resulting in a two-thirds decrease in dues in some areas. The financial shortfall has been covered entirely through donations from WAI's board of directors.

WAI's global mentoring programme uses artificial intelligence to match mentors and mentees based on their experience, career goals, location and professional challenges. Coffman cited last year's Mentor of the Year recipient, based in Dubai, who successfully mentored a member in the US as an example of the programme's international reach.
Coffman noted that despite the name, around 20% of WAI's members are men, and two board members are male. She said the organisation does not discriminate and welcomes male allies.
